metadata.title: Multi-station rainfall hazard screen
metadata.selection: Storms with at least two stations at high or very-high station-specific intensity.
metadata.method: Each station event is ranked against its own complete event history (S903 and S904, with under a year of record, against S50). This is a rainfall-hazard screen, not a record of confirmed flooding.
metadata.class_definition: Elevated: P90–P95; high: P95–P99; very high: at least P99, or P95 with antecedent rainfall at least P90.
metadata.coverage_note: Reporting stations grow from 2 (2017–2019) to 5 (from May 2026); the denominator is shown for every storm, so counts are not comparable across years.
